quote: FY2024 10-K R89 (Schedule of Accounts Payable and Equipment Project Payables, Nonrelated party), Dec. 31, 2023: "Trade payables | 4,701"; "Supply chain finance programs | 1,642"; "Equipment project payables | 1,096"; "Non-income based tax payables | 461"; "Accounts payable and equipment project payables | 7,900". R4 Related party: "Accounts payable and equipment project payables | 532". FY2025 10-K 0001996810-26-000015 R86 tags Dec. 31, 2024 "Trade payables | 4,966" (AccountsPayableTradeCurrent) = nonrelated trade 4,942 (FY2024 R89) + related-party 24 (FY2024 R4), so the filer's own AP split = nonrelated trade payables + the related-party line. 2023: 4,701 + 532 = 5,233.
rule_proposal: ap_split_trade_plus_related: when the face prints AP only inside a combined line and the note splits the nonrelated part into Trade payables + other payables, accounts_payable = nonrelated Trade payables + the related-party line of the same column, accepted only when a later 10-K's undimensioned AccountsPayableTradeCurrent equals that same sum for a column both filings present (here 2024: 4,942+24=4,966). Extends register ap_related_sum and the founder split-combined choice (2026-11-16 (3))

Identity: Current assets 27,428 = cash 1,551 + inventories 8,253 + contract assets 8,339 + other 352 + held for sale 1,444 + receivables 7,489. rule_proposal: related_party_member_sum: when a face line is printed only on RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis members (no undimensioned fact), the data point = Nonrelated + Related member values of the same column, accepted only if the statement total (current assets) ties with the sum

quote: FY2024 10-K R78 Schedule of Goodwill, column 12 months ended Dec. 31, 2023: "Balance at beginning of period | 4,437 | 4,164" (2024 | 2023 columns) -> Dec. 31, 2022 goodwill 4,164. companyfacts Goodwill 2022-12-31 = 4164000000 in 0001996810-25-000011. The year 2022 is presented by the FY2024 10-K (FY-2 IS/CF column), so it is not a pre-filing year; the equity statement also prints "Ending balance at Dec. 31, 2022 | 11,607".
rule_proposal: rollforward_opening_balance: an instant printed as the beginning balance of a periodic filing's note roll-forward is a printed instant (same family as the equity-statement/CF balance-row ruling of 2026-11-17)

quote: FY2024 10-K: cash-flow statement (R6) FY2022 column prints no share-based compensation line; Note SHARE-BASED COMPENSATION expense table (R117) prints only "2024 | Share-based compensation expense (pre-tax) $155". Full-text search of gev-20241231.htm finds no 2023/2022 SBC amount (carve-out years under GE plans before the April 2, 2024 spin-off). companyfacts has no ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense fact for 2022 or 2023 in any GEV filing.
rule_proposal: carve_out_sbc_not_presented: in a spin-off's carve-out years (before its own equity plan exists) where no periodic filing prints an SBC amount (CF line, note table or text), hide sbc as pre_spin_not_presented; needs a ruling because sbc is not on VERIFIED_ABSENT_HIDE (it failed round 2)

quote: Same as 2022: R6 FY2023 column has no SBC line; R117 prints 2024 only ("Share-based compensation expense (pre-tax) $155"); no SBC fact for 2023 in companyfacts; the FY2025 10-K 0001996810-26-000015 SBC table covers 2025 and 2024 only.

FY2024 10-K Statement of Changes in Equity: "Ending balance (in shares) at Dec. 31, 2023 | 0"; BS R4 Dec. 31, 2023 "Common stock ... | 0"; shares were first issued at the April 2, 2024 spin-off ("Issuance of common stock in connection with the Spin-Off ... (in shares) | 274,000,000").
rule_proposal: carve_out_zero_shares: a printed 0 share balance in a carve-out equity statement is a printed instant (2026-11-17 ruling) and is shown as 0; per-share and market-cap metrics must treat 0 shares as not computable (null), never divide by it
